review_method: Human/agent source review; live authenticated behavior was not tested.

features.title: Sticker-only server messages
features.rollout: Flag stickers; the sticker must belong to the server. It occupies the whole message: content, embeds, components and files stay empty.

typed.reason: CreateMessage and UiMessageBody have no sticker_id field or typed sticker constructor.

low_level.reason: Client::request/Api::request can submit raw sticker_id JSON; callers supply exclusivity, UUID, scope and rollout checks. This is request transport support only.

validated_bindings.reason: send_message parses a typed UiMessageBody and validates against the bundled schema, which lacks sticker_id; there is no safe sticker binding.

worker.reason: WorkerContext::api can send raw JSON through the parent. Typed message helpers and validated bindings do not implement sticker semantics. Workers require hot-reload.

cli_mcp.reason: CLI request can submit raw JSON. Named send_message CLI/MCP tools lack a sticker workflow and its validation; MCP has no arbitrary request tool. CLI/MCP compilation requires cli.

features.title: use_activities permission
features.rollout: Documented role/everyone permission and channel/category override key. Activities remain in testing; no arbitrary-actor effective permission precedence is established.

typed.reason: Permissions uses string keys, Permission::new accepts names, and PermissionOverride uses string lists. No new enum variant is needed for typed requests.

low_level.reason: Raw JSON preserves the key. Platform authorization still determines access.

validated_bindings.reason: Role permission dictionaries are extensible, but bundled Override enums omit use_activities; validated channel/category override operations reject this documented key.

worker.reason: Shared ApiExt and raw proxy calls can carry the key; validated override bindings retain the old schema restriction. Workers require hot-reload.

cli_mcp.reason: Raw/direct CLI requests can carry the key; named validated override tools inherit the bundled enum gap. CLI/MCP requires cli.

features.title: Select menus
features.rollout: Flag bot_selects; endpoint docs describe test-server rollout. Up to 25 options; a select occupies its action row.

typed.reason: SelectMenu, SelectOption and UiMessageBody builders validate bounds; interactive_events and UI handlers are opt-in for receiving values.

low_level.reason: Raw JSON sends and callback requests are available; callers own validation/response state when bypassing helpers.

validated_bindings.reason: send_message accepts UiMessageBody with select validation and normalization; authorization/availability requirements still apply. This row covers sending selects, not a named callback binding.

worker.reason: on_ui_interaction or ui_api opts into parent protocol v7 for UI values/callbacks; parent interactive_events must be enabled. Requires hot-reload.

cli_mcp.reason: Named message tools preserve select payloads. Polling exposes raw events, but CLI/MCP is not the native typed interaction-dispatch runtime. Requires cli.

features.title: Modal forms and submissions
features.rollout: Flag bot_modals; test-server rollout. Open as an initial eligible interaction response, not from modal_submit; up to five inputs.

typed.reason: Modal/TextInput builders and show_modal coordinate validation, initial response ownership and opt-in UI dispatch.

low_level.reason: Raw interaction callbacks are possible; direct callers must preserve deadline and response ownership.

validated_bindings.reason: The capability catalogue has no named modal-opening/submission binding; typed UiApiExt is a separate API.

worker.reason: Opt-in protocol v7 UI forwarding supports modal callbacks and values. Requires hot-reload and a compatible parent; interactive_events is enabled in the parent.

cli_mcp.reason: CLI request can issue callbacks and event tools expose raw submissions. There is no named MCP modal workflow or native typed CLI dispatcher. Requires cli.

features.title: Custom emojis used in one message
features.rollout: Flag bot_emoji_lookup; test-server restriction in endpoint/catalogue. Validate server/message scope and requester/bot access independently.

typed.reason: Client and UiApiExt expose get_message_emojis and retain typed emoji metadata.

low_level.reason: GET through Client/Api is available. A successful bot read does not prove requester authority.

validated_bindings.reason: get_message_emojis has schema, scoped authorization and rollout requirements. Unestablished checks block execution.

worker.reason: Shared UiApiExt/proxy reads preserve typed results. Requires hot-reload; no new worker event protocol is required for this ordinary read.

cli_mcp.reason: platform get_message_emojis and the matching MCP catalogue tool expose the operation. Requires cli.

features.title: Emoji creation: documented 2 MB image limit
features.rollout: Endpoint description says PNG/GIF/WebP up to 2 MB, Manage Emoji, flag bot_emojis/test servers; tag text drops testing, so use the stricter endpoint restriction until clarified. Platform MB units are not defined here.

typed.reason: CreateEmoji and multipart request_upload still cap decoded images at 1,048,576 bytes. Smaller images are supported, the full newly documented range is unavailable.

low_level.reason: Raw JSON/base64 Client::request can avoid the typed cap; request_upload enforces 1 MiB. No authenticated test establishes acceptance above that limit.

validated_bindings.reason: create_emoji validation uses CreateEmoji and retains the 1 MiB bound.

worker.reason: Shared typed/parent upload paths retain the 1 MiB limit; raw JSON remains possible. Requires hot-reload.

cli_mcp.reason: emoji-upload and validated create_emoji tools retain the 1 MiB cap. CLI request is a raw JSON escape hatch. Requires cli.

features.title: Gateway event intake
features.rollout: Gateway is documented as beta; availability/denial is handled through preferred polling fallback or explicit gateway-only behavior.

typed.reason: BotBuilder::gateway opts into WebSocket events, heartbeat/resume and polling fallback; gateway_only selects stricter behavior. Requires gateway.

low_level.reason: WebSocket event intake is a transport runner, not an arbitrary HTTP request.

validated_bindings.reason: Command capability bindings execute API operations; they do not select event intake.

worker.reason: The parent owns gateway intake and dispatches admitted events to workers. Requires gateway in the parent and hot-reload for workers.

cli_mcp.reason: The CLI/MCP event tools use polling; compiling gateway does not make the CLI open a gateway connection.

features.title: Gateway JSON API requests
features.rollout: Opt-in; each connection must advertise ready.requests=true. Eligible JSON calls only; uploads, binary calls and /events use HTTPS.

typed.reason: configure_gateway_requests opts into the parent-owned bounded response pump; unknown submitted mutations never fall back or replay. Requires gateway.

low_level.reason: Eligible Client/Api JSON requests use the configured connection. No connection/capability chooses HTTPS before submission. Requires gateway.

validated_bindings.reason: Bindings use the same Client transport without weakening validation or permission checks. Requires gateway for the configured parent transport.

worker.reason: Workers use the parent-selected transport. Requires gateway in the parent and hot-reload; api_once additionally requires protocol v6 opt-in.

cli_mcp.reason: CLI/MCP does not own a gateway connection or expose gateway-request configuration.

features.title: Hosted call activity runtime
features.rollout: custom_activities remains in testing. Registered HTTPS pages use the browser JavaScript bridge; discovery/verification differs for verified bots, unverified bots and DM calls.

typed.reason: The documented activity runtime is a hosted browser page. It is not a Rust bot REST endpoint.

low_level.reason: No bot REST activity lifecycle endpoint is established in this OpenAPI snapshot.

validated_bindings.reason: There is no documented bot REST runtime operation to bind; use_activities permissions are reviewed separately.

worker.reason: Worker cogs do not replace the hosted browser runtime.

cli_mcp.reason: CLI/MCP is not the browser postMessage activity bridge.

scope: Feature-level review. The operation inventory is deliberately unknown; a reviewed field or feature does not certify an entire endpoint.
